answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The violet edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 128 clones produces a signature the zephyr analysis flags immediately. A hostile operator must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the jetty settlement applies the void retroactively. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
